verdict.rationale: Unreal documents its own programmatic surfaces: Python editor scripting can control the editor and automate asset, level and actor tasks. The Remote Control API can call any Blueprint-callable function over HTTP or WebSocket, and the cook command can be run from the command line. However, no evidence claims full UI parity: Remote Control is scoped to Blueprint-callable functions, the Python API is marked Experimental, and there is no independent check that every editor action can be scripted. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a stable (non-experimental) Python API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
